decisions.reason: The request to display shower, sink, and door dimensions changes the dimensioned drawing deliverable but does not change Unit 3 bathroom geometry or fixture locations.
The source requests display of shower, sink, and door dimensions and does not change the open-plan kitchen cabinetry configuration.
Showing fixture and door dimensions on the plan does not alter the Unit 1 en-suite type, connection, or fixture placement.
The dimension-labeling request does not modify any partition wall placement, demolition, construction, or preservation rule.
The source changes only which fixture and door dimensions must be shown; it neither resolves nor changes the common-corridor layout or its existing ambiguity.
